title: DNS Analyzer
monitoring_disabled_desc: Monitoring is disabled by default. Enter a Source IP to start sniffing packets.
shared_report_desc: This is a captured snapshot. Real-time updates are disabled.
tour_welcome_content:
A real-time war room for network traffic analysis.

This tool helps you monitor connection paths, undersea cable flows, and potential risks. Let's see how to set it up!
tour_setup_content:
To ensure stable connection and precise analysis, please configure your DNS:

Primary DNS (This System): `103.136.x.x` 
Secondary DNS: `1.1.1.1` or `8.8.8.8` 

--- 
• Windows: Settings -> Network & Internet -> Ethernet/Wi-Fi -> Edit IP settings -> Manual.
• macOS: System Settings -> Network -> Wi-Fi/Ethernet -> Details -> DNS tab.
• iOS: Settings -> Wi-Fi -> tap (i) icon -> Configure DNS -> Manual.
• Android: Settings -> Network & Internet -> Private DNS or DNS settings in Wi-Fi details.

⚠️ Important: Always set a secondary DNS to prevent disconnection during system maintenance.
tour_monitoring_content: Enter your device's IP here to start receiving live packet data.
tour_dashboard_content: Real-time statistics of query volume and foreign traffic ratio to help identify abnormal activity.
tour_map_content: Visualize global connections with WebGL-powered flow animations and traceroute paths.
tour_table_content: Detailed logs including app detection and latency. Click 'Zap' for Traceroute.
tour_traceroute_content: The map will auto-zoom and draw a yellow path to visualize network hops and bottlenecks.
